comparison.scope: Read all nine latest submitted casual prompts, plus Dratini plan and actual outputs.

face.why: Long flowing body and crystal curves become a narrow elongated face, defined long jaw, quiet downturned almond eyes, long brows and medium mouth.

casual.scene: At a seaside changing-cabin deck after a morning swim, body side-on and face turned toward viewer, lightly leaning against a wooden rail while unfolding a white towel with both hands separated at waist height. Ocean and striped canvas shade behind, both complete hands and forearms visible, no other figures.
casual.outfit: Fully lined opaque sky-blue one-piece swimsuit with white side panels, secure halter neckline and small covered-waist cutouts, tiny blue crystal stud earrings. Bare arms shoulders and small side-waist areas, chest and pelvis fully covered; no armor or large head ornaments.

casual.scene: On an empty grassy hill weather-observation path at cool dawn, standing upright while carrying a small unlettered handheld barometer between both separated hands at waist height. Low mist and layered clouds in distance, complete head and boots visible, gentle breeze.
casual.outfit: Opaque white sleeveless belted short trench dress over secure navy fitted shorts, low blue field boots, tiny crystal pendant. Bare arms shoulders and legs; contemporary field-observation clothing, no armor, horn circlet or wing cape.

casual.scene: Inside a quiet coastal heritage tea pavilion at late evening, standing formally and presenting a broad lacquer tea tray at waist height, hands far apart supporting its left and right edges. Two plain porcelain cups on tray, soft paper-lantern light, head to above knees with whole hands visible, no writing and no other figures.
casual.outfit: Modern blue silk heritage-inspired wrap midi dress with one bare shoulder, secure opaque white inner bodice, curved sash fastening and a modest side slit over opaque shorts, tiny crystal earrings. Soft sewn fabric with bare shoulder arms and lower legs; no armor or large costume ornaments.
